messages:
sara: Procurement from VitaCare wants us to run a short POC: they need a redacted ISO snippet, SOC2 one-pager, a signed pen-test attestation, and a 3-4 hour weekend vulnerability scan against staging. They asked whether scan facilitation is included and what creds we need. cc @mike @toni

mike: We can provide the redacted ISO and SOC2 one-pager. Pen-test attestation is our standard doc; security signs but legal sometimes requests tiny wording changes which can add time.

toni: Ops: we can run the scan but need at minimum: completed ATO form, SSO account for the engineer, and firewall allowlist for our scanner egress IPs 24h before the window. If they prefer to run it, we hand over staging creds and a target list.

infra-bot: HOSTED_SCANNER_IPS: 3.208.45.66, 3.208.45.67. Bastion fingerprint available on request.

sara: They suggested Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC. Prefer Redwood to run it. Procurement also asked if we store any of the scan output—can we confirm policy?

sec-bot: SECURITY: We do not persist raw customer scan output in production. We retain a short ops log for reporting and root-cause analysis which is redacted; standard NDA applies if customer data is in scope. Pen-test attestation template located at /compliance/templates/pen_test_attest_latest.docx. Manager approval required for signature; typical turnaround 1 business day if no redlines.

billing: Pricing note: artifact exchange (ISO/SOC2) included in standard POC. Scan facilitation & reporting is billable. Suggest line item "POC scan facilitation & reporting (up to 4h) - $975" to avoid scope pushback.

mike: I'll add the $975 line to the quote and attach the attestation template to the opportunity. Toni please confirm ops availability and presign workflow.

toni: Confirmed we can do the Saturday slot if allowlist confirmed 24h prior. I'll prepare presigned proofpack upload; default presign TTL 48h. Presign command: aws s3 presign s3://proofpacks/vitacare/iso_redacted.zip --expires-in 172800

sara: Procurement also requested an explicit line on the quote that says "Customer responsible for firewall changes and ATO completion". Please add that so PO managers don't get confused.

billing: Added note to quote and labeled line item accordingly. Attached attestation template in CRM.

mike: Next steps summary: 1) toni generate presign and upload redacted ISO; 2) mike update quote with $975 and the firewall/ATO note; 3) customer to confirm firewall allowlist for 3.208.45.66/67 and complete ATO + NDA; 4) sec to sign attestation after legal review.

toni: Uploaded redacted ISO and posted presign link (placeholder): https://redwood-evidence.s3.amazonaws.com/vitacare/iso_redacted_presign?token=abcXYZ

sara: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with VitaCare procurement to share the presign, confirm the allowlist, and accept the quote. If legal redlines the attestation I'll loop in #sec-legal. :thumbsup:
